packs.name: Music: records, gigs and friends
packs.description: A small record collection with the artists, gigs, venues and friends around it, including who signed what and where.

packs.name: Recipes
packs.description: A few family and cookbook recipes with ingredient tables, full methods, and where each one came from.

packs.name: Movies
packs.description: Films you have watched, where and with whom, plus the posters you have collected and who signed them.

packs.name: Comic con: signed posters and photo ops
packs.description: Posters and prints signed by many people at many events, with each signature kept as its own entry, plus the selfies and photo ops from the same days.

packs.name: Electronic parts
packs.description: A small parts drawer: what is in stock, what is running low, what each build uses and who sells it.

packs.name: Board games
packs.description: A shelf of board games with their publishers and designers, the game nights they came out at, and a wishlist of the ones still to get.

packs.name: Record formats: vinyl, CDs and tapes
packs.description: One parent type, Music media, with Vinyl, CD, Cassette and MiniDisc as subtypes: the fields every format shares live on the parent, each format adds its own.

packs.name: Film formats: discs and tapes
packs.description: One parent type, Film media, with Laser Disc, DVD, Blu-ray and VHS as subtypes, so you can look at every copy of a film together or one format at a time.

packs.name: Currency: coins, notes and tokens
packs.description: One parent type, Currency, with Coin, Banknote and Token as subtypes, each with the details that only suit it.

packs.name: Extra board games
packs.description: A few more games for the Board games shelf, an expansion, and a weeknight collection that mixes old and new.

packs.name: Board game storage
packs.description: Rooms, a bookcase, a shelf and a tin box for the Board games shelf, so each game has a place and you can see what is in each one.
